meta.title: Commercial bid submission with a special character '#' in a specification field

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on its Responses tab, where the vendor bid is already selected for a pending proposal.
Attempt to reject the selected vendor bid from the buyer's Responses view.

args.text: Can not reject a bid which is selected for proposal

steps.note: Verify Procol shows the required refusal message.
Verify the bid remains Active after the rejected action.
